test_title: PYST 4: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Consumers sometimes has a good ability to identify counterfeit logos when the legitimate brand is well-recognized.

options.text: Consumers sometimes has a good ability to

solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the third part of the given sentence, the singular form of the verb 'has' is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject **'Consumers'** is **plural**.
 
• When the subject is plural, the verb should also be in its plural form. Therefore, the plural form of the verb 'have' should be used in place of the singular form 'has'.

 

Hence, the correct sentence is: *Consumers sometimes **have **a good ability to identify counterfeit logos when the legitimate brand is well-recognized.*
